## NOG Schedules Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call


10/07/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 113 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/492547254/files/doc_news/NOG-Schedules-Third-Quarter-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. (NYSE: NOG) (“NOG” or the “Company”) announced today that it plans to issue its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, after the market closes. Additionally, the Company will host a conference call on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Central Time.


Those wishing to listen to the conference call may do so via phone or the Company’s webcast.


**Conference Call and Webcast Details :**

November 6, 2026


Time:


8:00 a.m. Central Time


Dial-In:


(833) 461-5787


International Dial-In:

139 482 049

[Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F694699964&esheet=54618108&newsitemid=20261007628453&lan=en-US&anchor=Third+Quarter+2026+Earnings+Conference+Call&index=1&md5=47699b7108eb032726a6ff782f1ecd2e)

Dial-In:

International Dial-In:


(929) 828-5978

139 482 049


An archive of the conference call webcast will also be available on NOG’s website through November 5, 2027.


**ABOUT NOG**


Northern Oil and Gas (NOG) is the largest publicly traded dedicated non-operator in the United States, built on a differentiated strategy of acquiring non-operated minority working interests and mineral rights across the premier basins of North America. By combining deep industry relationships with disciplined capital allocation, NOG has built a scaled, diversified portfolio that generates durable production and strong cash flow for its shareholders. More information about NOG can be found at[www.noginc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.noginc.com&esheet=54618108&newsitemid=20261007628453&lan=en-US&anchor=www.noginc.com&index=2&md5=405032d63b7da15310e143155f7c99e6) .
